objective: Continuation authorized by the owner on 2026-10-30 ('Yes, let's continue'), taking the recommendation of WAVE-UNIQUENESS-20261029-001. The previous epics fixed the Sierpinski gluing and classified the laws it admits; this epic fixes the law (the standing wave, and signed not-all-equal in particular) and asks which gluings it admits. Setting: a gadget is a finite set of triangles (vertices in roles a, b, c) glued at shared vertices, with corners A, B, C each in exactly one triangle, in roles a, b, c respectively; inner vertices lie in at least two triangles; the gadget is connected. Its corner relation sums every inner vertex; the law is exact on it when the corner relation is a nonzero multiple of the law; an exact gadget builds a tower by substituting itself into its own triangles. Scoping (not evidence): the flip parity of the sector expansion is odd for every such gadget; exactness reduces to the vanishing of the six corner sums with mixed corner sectors; locking frames suffice but are not necessary, since four-triangle gadgets exact by cancellation exist. Questions: (A) prove the criterion and its sufficient mechanisms, and whether a knot can build towers of every growth exponent; (B) classify all gadgets with at most five triangles. Intuitions targeted: space from logic without a drawn space (the law selecting its gluings); everything relational. No time constraints.
status: Complete 2026-10-30: the harmony selects gluings by interference (six signed sums; locking plus odd parity refuted), with no single space and no selected growth exponent; census of all gadgets to five triangles; nonnegative not-all-equal laws need seven triangles (sharp), the signed knot three; three-fold contacts are knots on phases and their seven-triangle spaces are the Fano gadgets. Ticket A's Theorem 5 corrected by C. Recommendation: Continue with the knot's three-fold spaces (2/3).
